comment: Outcome ambiguity: item 1 of the dispositiv dismisses the Sistierungsgesuch (abgewiesen); item 2 is 'Auf die Beschwerde wird nicht eingetreten' (the actual result on the appeal). Per brief rule 'item 1 only', outcome set to dismissed. If the procedural-request exception should apply as for 'vereinigt', this should be inadmissible. Extended two chains (#4, #8). | caller: item 1 only rejects the Sistierungsgesuch; item 2 decides the appeal (nicht eingetreten).
